description.description: Human-readable description of the service's purpose

mode_args.description: Space-separated arguments: '-d' for decrypt, '-e' for encrypt, optionally followed by -O <sector_offset>

encryption_type.description: Encryption algorithm variant: AES128, AES192, or AES256

gpg_key_file.description: Path to GPG-encrypted key file. If non-empty, implies -K <file> mode

passphrase_source.description: Either '-P <file>' or '-p <fd>' (e.g., '-p3' for fd3), or empty if using GPG key file or interactive prompt

gpg_home.description: GPG home directory for public/private key lookups (implies -G <dir>)

wait_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before prompting for passphrase (implies -w <n>)

passphrase_file.description: File path for -P option (used only when passphrase_source uses '-P <file>' and gpg_key_file is empty)

passphrase_fd.description: File descriptor number for -p option (used only when passphrase_source uses '-p <fd>' and gpg_key_file is empty)
